what: Marc Lou analyzed 10,646 startups on TrustMRR: 5,845 made $0 in last 30 days, 3,744 under $1k, only 24 made $100k+. Highlights distribution problem over building.
why_us: Shows extreme concentration of revenue; most micro-SaaS fail on distribution. Validates need for validated demand signals before building.

what: beehiiv crossed $3m MRR. Growth: $0→$1M in 36 months, $1M→$2M in 16, $2M→$3M in 9 months. Now adding ~$100k MRR every 2.5 weeks.
why_us: Clear acceleration in newsletter/email SaaS. Proven demand for creator tools with strong retention and growth.

what: Smooth AI crossed $300k+ ARR in 8 months. 17k+ users, 1,700 paying, 65% MRR growth last 2 months, ~80% organic. Focus on real-time AI for meetings.
why_us: Strong organic growth in AI meeting assistant space. Shows willingness to pay for performance enhancement tools.

what: Analysis of 481 AI agent startups on TrustMRR: 14 made >$10k in last 30 days (84% of all revenue). Top: Postiz $407k, AiSDR $177k, etc. Many $0.
why_us: Concrete numbers on which AI agent products actually monetize. Copyable patterns for agentic SaaS.

what: FootballGPT (one-person): $4,778/mo, 505 active subs on TrustMRR. Niche: soccer coaches, weekly drills/session plans. $2.99/wk.
why_us: Classic micro-SaaS success: single niche, simple recurring job, low price, verified revenue.

what: G2 reviews: Canva users frustrated that essential features (background remover, magic resize, elements) locked behind expensive Pro. Premium too costly for casual users.
why_us: Repeated complaint about feature gating and price. Opportunity for more affordable/open alternatives or freemium with better free tier.
engagement: Hundreds of mentions of limited features / too expensive

what: Notion G2: steep learning curve, slow performance on large pages/databases, confusing interface, search issues. Users want better folders/sidebar and offline/mobile.
why_us: High volume of complaints on UX and performance. Room for simpler, faster alternatives focused on specific use cases.

what: Slack G2: per-user pricing becomes very expensive as teams scale; free tier limited history. Users seek cheaper or more flexible alternatives.
why_us: Classic enterprise SaaS pricing pain. Open-source (Mattermost) and self-hosted options popular as response.

what: YO Ecosystem Vault: $3.12M deposits, USDC lending ~9% APY, loopers up to 47% ROE with leverage on Morpho. Growing after market dip.
why_us: Solid real-world yield numbers with TVL and utilization data. Attractive for stablecoin strategies.

what: High-engagement post listing free open-source alternatives to expensive SaaS (Notion→Appflowy, Slack→Mattermost, etc.). 12k+ likes shows widespread desire for cheaper/self-hosted options.
why_us: Massive signal that users actively seek alternatives to paid tools due to cost. Opportunity in better OSS packaging or hybrid models.
